title: The pager goes off
hints: README → New syntax: grep's basic form is `grep PATTERN FILE`, and the file is `"$DATA/app.log"`.
Every line you want contains the literal text `ERROR`, so that word alone is the whole pattern.
Same shape on fake input: `printf 'INFO ok\nERROR bad\n' | grep INFO` prints `INFO ok`.
`grep WARN "$DATA/app.log"` would print the warnings. Swap in the level you need.
